```{r cars}
# Wczytanie pakietów
library(survival)
library(timereg)

# Przygotowanie danych
data(lung, package = "survival")

# 1. Czyszczenie danych: prop.odds nie lubi brakujących wartości (NA)
# Zbiór już zawiera zmienną sex2
lung_clean <- na.omit(lung[, c("time", "status", "age", "ph.ecog", "ph.karno", "sex")])


# 2. Dopasowanie modelu proporcjonalnych szans
out <- prop.odds(Event(time, status ==2) ~ age + ph.ecog + ph.karno + sex,
                 data = lung_clean, n.sim = 0)
# Wyświetla tabelę współczynników dla age, ph.ecog, ph.karno i sex
summary(out)
# Tylko współczynniki stałe
out$gamma

# Nazwy zmiennych dla jasności
names(out$gamma) <- c("age", "ph.ecog", "ph.karno", "sex")
print(out$gamma)
# 3. Wyciągnięcie punktów czasowych z modelu
times <- out$cum[, 1]

# 4. Predykcja krzywej baseline (kowariaty = 0)
pred_base <- predict(out, X = 1, Z = matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = 4), 
                     times = times, n.sim = 0)
S_base <- pred_base$S0[1, ]
H_base <- -log(S_base)

# 5. Funkcja hazardu baseline (różnica skumulowanego hazardu)
h_base <- diff(c(0, H_base))

# 6. Definicja kowariatów dla dwóch pacjentek
# Kolejność: age, ph.ecog, ph.karno, sex2
Z_pat <- matrix(c(70, 1, 90, 1,   # Pacjentka 1: ph.ecog = 1
                  70, 2, 90, 1),  # Pacjentka 2: ph.ecog = 2
                byrow = TRUE, nrow = 2)

# 7. Predykcja dla profili pacjentek
pred_pat <- predict(out, X = rbind(1, 1), Z = Z_pat, 
                    times = times, n.sim = 0)
S_pat1 <- pred_pat$S0[1, ]
S_pat2 <- pred_pat$S0[2, ]
H_pat1 <- -log(S_pat1)
H_pat2 <- -log(S_pat2)

# 8. Funkcje hazardu dla pacjentek
h_pat1 <- diff(c(0, H_pat1))
h_pat2 <- diff(c(0, H_pat2))

# 9. Zapis do plików CSV
results <- list(
  "baseline_survival.csv" = data.frame(time = times, value = S_base),
  "baseline_cumhazard.csv" = data.frame(time = times, value = H_base),
  "baseline_hazard.csv" = data.frame(time = times, value = h_base),
  "survival_ph1.csv" = data.frame(time = times, value = S_pat1),
  "survival_ph2.csv" = data.frame(time = times, value = S_pat2),
  "cumhazard_ph1.csv" = data.frame(time = times, value = H_pat1),
  "cumhazard_ph2.csv" = data.frame(time = times, value = H_pat2),
  "hazard_ph1.csv" = data.frame(time = times, value = h_pat1),
  "hazard_ph2.csv" = data.frame(time = times, value = h_pat2)
)

for(name in names(results)) {
  write.csv(results[[name]], name, row.names = FALSE)
}

print("Przetwarzanie zakończone. Pliki CSV zostały wygenerowane.")
# 10. Funkcja do wyświetlenia wykresów
plot_results <- function() {
  par(mfrow = c(2, 3))  # Ustawienie siatki 2x3 dla 6 wykresów
  
  # Wykres 1: Survival baseline
  plot(times, S_base, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 2,
       main = "Baseline Survival Function",
       xlab = "Time (days)", ylab = "S(t)",
       ylim = c(0, 1))
  grid()
  
  # Wykres 2: Cumulative Hazard baseline
  plot(times, H_base, type = "l", col = "red", lwd = 2,
       main = "Baseline Cumulative Hazard",
       xlab = "Time (days)", ylab = "H(t)")
  grid()
  
  # Wykres 3: Hazard baseline
  plot(times, h_base, type = "l", col = "darkgreen", lwd = 2,
       main = "Baseline Hazard Function",
       xlab = "Time (days)", ylab = "h(t)")
  grid()
  
  # Wykres 4: Survival - porównanie pacjentek
  plot(times, S_pat1, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 2,
       main = "Survival Functions Comparison",
       xlab = "Time (days)", ylab = "S(t)",
       ylim = c(0, 1))
  lines(times, S_pat2, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  legend("topright", legend = c("ph.ecog = 1", "ph.ecog = 2"),
         col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2)
  grid()
  
  # Wykres 5: Cumulative Hazard - porównanie pacjentek
  plot(times, H_pat1, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 2,
       main = "Cumulative Hazard Comparison",
       xlab = "Time (days)", ylab = "H(t)")
  lines(times, H_pat2, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  legend("topleft", legend = c("ph.ecog = 1", "ph.ecog = 2"),
         col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2)
  grid()
  
  # Wykres 6: Hazard - porównanie pacjentek
  plot(times, h_pat1, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 2,
       main = "Hazard Functions Comparison",
       xlab = "Time (days)", ylab = "h(t)")
  lines(times, h_pat2, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  legend("topright", legend = c("ph.ecog = 1", "ph.ecog = 2"),
         col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2)
  grid()
  
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))  # Powrót do domyślnego układu
}

plot_results()

print(out$gamma)
```
